title: Smiling Father and Toddler Son by Garage, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century black-and-white snapshot capturing a loving moment between a father and his young toddler son. The little boy, dressed in a striped shirt and overalls, stands proudly on a small folding camp stool with his arms wrapped affectionately around his father's neck. The father kneels beside him, smiling warmly at the camera. They are positioned outdoors on a concrete driveway in front of a white siding building with large wooden cross-braced garage doors in bright daylight.
